content: Git worktree hazards: all worktrees share one .git object store; each worktree gets its own index/index.lock under .git/worktrees/<name>/, so concurrent writes within a single worktree still contend but separate worktrees do not directly collide on index.lock. Crashed agent processes leave orphaned worktrees with branches still checked out, blocking retry; mitigate with try/finally git worktree remove and periodic git worktree prune sweeps. git worktree prune can delete worktrees still needed (e.g., on unmounted network/removable storage) unless locked with git worktree lock. Worktrees with submodules cannot be moved. New worktrees do not inherit gitignored/untracked build artifacts from the main tree - requires explicit setup step.
